rules.title: Head protection
rules.plain_english_rule: Protective helmets are required where work exposes employees to possible head injury from impact, falling or flying objects, or electrical shock and burns.
rules.recommended_action: Pause exposed work, provide suitable head protection, and have a supervisor verify the hazard and protection before resuming.
rules.scope_note: A missing helmet is a potential violation only where a head-injury hazard exists. High-visibility clothing is not a universal requirement under this rule.

rules.title: Keep clear of hoisted loads
rules.plain_english_rule: Minimize exposure along hoisting routes. Keep workers out of the fall zone of a stationary suspended load except for specified tasks; only workers needed to receive a landing load may enter its fall zone.
rules.recommended_action: Stop the lift when people are exposed; clear and control the fall zone, then have the lift supervisor verify permitted essential tasks.
rules.scope_note: The standard has task-specific exceptions. Camera proximity is a review signal, not proof that no exception applies.

rules.title: Unprotected edges
rules.plain_english_rule: At an unprotected walking or working edge six feet or more above a lower level, protect employees with guardrails, safety nets, or personal fall arrest systems.
rules.recommended_action: Keep workers away from the exposed edge until a competent site reviewer verifies suitable fall protection.
rules.scope_note: This scenario concerns unprotected sides and edges. Other tasks and surfaces have different requirements.

rules.title: Excavation cave-in protection
rules.plain_english_rule: Protect employees in excavations against cave-ins with an adequate protective system, except in stable rock or an excavation under five feet where a competent person finds no indication of potential cave-in.
rules.recommended_action: Keep workers out of an unprotected excavation until a competent person evaluates conditions and provides the required protective system.
rules.scope_note: Depth, soil conditions, and the competent-person determination cannot be established reliably from a single image.

rules.title: Electrical exposure
rules.plain_english_rule: Do not permit work close enough to an electrical power circuit for contact unless employees are protected by de-energizing and grounding the circuit or by effective insulation or other guarding.
rules.recommended_action: Stop exposed work, isolate the area, and have qualified personnel verify de-energization or effective guarding before work resumes.
rules.scope_note: An image cannot establish whether a circuit is energized or electrically safe.

rules.title: Reversing vehicle visibility
rules.plain_english_rule: A covered motor vehicle with an obstructed rear view may not be operated in reverse unless it has a reverse alarm audible above surrounding noise or an observer signals that reversing is safe.
rules.recommended_action: Pause reversing where workers may be exposed. Confirm a functioning audible reverse alarm or an observer directing safe movement, and keep the reversing path clear.
rules.scope_note: Section 1926.601 covers motor vehicles operating within an off-highway jobsite not open to public traffic and excludes equipment covered by 1926.602. A camera cannot establish alarm audibility or the driver rearward view.

rules.title: Hoisted load exposure
rules.plain_english_rule: When available, use hoisting routes that minimize employee exposure to hoisted loads, consistent with public safety.
rules.recommended_action: Pause load movement when a person is exposed between the load and a fixed object. Review the hoisting route and clear the exposure area before resuming.
rules.scope_note: This reference addresses hoisting route exposure; it is not a general pinch-point rule for all equipment. Confirm that the observed object is a hoisted load and assess the actual operation.

rules.title: Ladders near electrical equipment
rules.plain_english_rule: Ladders must have nonconductive siderails where the employee or ladder could contact exposed energized electrical equipment.
rules.recommended_action: Stop ladder use near the electrical exposure. Have qualified personnel control the electrical hazard and verify a suitable ladder with nonconductive siderails.
rules.scope_note: A photograph cannot prove that equipment is energized, exposed, or within contact distance, or establish ladder conductivity. This is a prompt for human assessment.
